"""Producer/consumer pipeline on a private event loop."""
import asyncio


async def _produce(queue, items, delay, loop):
    for item in items:
        await queue.put(item)
        await asyncio.sleep(delay, loop=loop)


async def _consume(queue, count):
    return [await queue.get() for _ in range(count)]


def pipeline(items, delay=0.001):
    loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
    try:
        queue = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=2, loop=loop)
        producer = asyncio.ensure_future(_produce(queue, items, delay, loop), loop=loop)
        consumer = asyncio.ensure_future(_consume(queue, len(items)), loop=loop)
        loop.run_until_complete(asyncio.wait([producer, consumer]))
        return consumer.result()
    finally:
        loop.close()

import sys
import unittest

import pytest

from app import aio, reloader, settings, specs, stamps, versions, xmlio


def test_pipeline_preserves_order():
    assert aio.pipeline([3, 1, 2, 5, 4]) == [3, 1, 2, 5, 4]


def test_reload_picks_up_changes(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.syspath_prepend(str(tmp_path))
    mod_file = tmp_path / "plug_mod.py"
    mod_file.write_text("VALUE = 1\n")
    import plug_mod
    assert plug_mod.VALUE == 1
    mod_file.write_text("VALUE = 22  # changed\n")
    reloader.reload_module(plug_mod)
    assert plug_mod.VALUE == 22
    mod_file.write_text("VALUE = 333  # changed again\n")
    assert reloader.reload_by_name("plug_mod").VALUE == 333
    sys.modules.pop("plug_mod", None)


def test_version_ordering():
    assert str(versions.newest(["1.9", "1.10", "1.2"])) == "1.10"
    assert versions.at_least("2.0", "1.10")
    assert not versions.at_least("1.2", "1.10")
    assert versions.parse("1.10").version[:2] == [1, 10]


def test_settings_is_a_mapping():
    conf = settings.Settings({"a": 1, "b": 2})
    assert settings.is_mapping(conf)
    assert dict(conf) == {"a": 1, "b": 2}
    assert len(conf) == 2 and conf.get("c", 9) == 9


def test_describe_signature():
    def handler(a, b=2, *rest, **extra):
        return a

    info = specs.describe(handler)
    assert info["args"] == ["a", "b"]
    assert info["defaults"] == (2,)
    assert info["varargs"] == "rest"
    assert info["accepts_kwargs"] is True


def test_xml_items():
    xml = '<list><item id="1">a</item><item id="2">b</item></list>'
    assert xmlio.items(xml) == [("1", "a"), ("2", "b")]
    assert xmlio.load(xml).tag == "list"


def test_numbers():
    assert xmlio.numbers("a1 b22 c333") == [1, 22, 333]


def test_read_all(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "f.txt"
    path.write_text("hello")
    assert xmlio.read_all(str(path)) == "hello"


def test_stamps():
    assert stamps.epoch_to_utc(0) == "1970-01-01T00:00:00"
    assert stamps.now_stamp().endswith("Z") and len(stamps.now_stamp()) == 20


class StampCase(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_epoch_roundtrip(self):
        self.assertEquals(stamps.epoch_to_utc(86400), "1970-01-02T00:00:00")
